# Brevrix (https://brevrix.com)

> Brevrix is a Full-Stack Web Engineering, Enterprise DevOps, and Digital Growth Studio based in Bangladesh, serving clients worldwide.

## Core Expertise & Services
- **DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure**: Linux (Ubuntu, CentOS, RHEL), Kubernetes (k8s, k3s, k0s, Helm), Docker, CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, GitOps, Trivy), Kong API Gateway, Harbor, Keycloak IAM.
- **Database & Messaging**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, ClickHouse, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ.
- **Web Development**: Ultra-fast Astro static websites, WordPress development, HTML/CSS, Tailwind CSS, Cloudflare Pages edge deployment.
- **AI & Automation**: Python, YOLOv5/OpenCV computer vision, n8n workflow automation.
- **Digital Marketing & Business Ops**: Technical SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Email Marketing, Financial Record Keeping & Project Coordination.

## Key Team Members
- **Md. Tanvir Ahmed**: Co-Founder, Web Developer, Digital Marketer & Financial Operations Lead (BBA Honours in Accounting).
- **Sadia Afrin Lubna**: Co-Founder & System/DevOps Engineer (BSc in CSE, experienced in Enterprise Linux, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, and Machine Learning).
